# Axial Realty LLC

> Boutique residential real estate brokerage and full-service property management firm serving the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex (North Texas), founded and led by Broker/Owner David Tung (董). Bilingual service in English and Mandarin Chinese (中文服務).

## About

- Company: Axial Realty LLC
- Broker / Owner: David Tung (董)
- Phone: (469) 980-8298
- Email: davidtung@axialrealty.com
- Website: https://axialrealty.com
- Primary service area: Dallas-Fort Worth (DFW) / North Texas, with deep focus on Collin and Denton counties
- Cities served: Frisco, Plano, McKinney, Allen, Prosper, Celina, Melissa, Anna, Lewisville, Flower Mound, Coppell, Richardson, and surrounding DFW suburbs
- Languages: English, Mandarin Chinese (中文)
- Texas Real Estate Commission required disclosure: IABS form is published at https://axialrealty.com/IABS-2026.pdf

## Services

- Residential real estate sales (buyer and seller representation)
- Residential leasing for tenants and landlords
- Full-service rental property management for individual investors and small portfolios (tenant screening, rent collection, maintenance coordination, monthly owner reporting)
- Free home valuation (CMA) for prospective sellers
- Relocation assistance for buyers moving to North Texas, including bilingual service for Mandarin-speaking clients
- Agent recruiting and mentorship for new and experienced licensed Texas real estate agents
